All 16 pinned repositories are present in the index and I verified content at the pinned commits (redux `3aa561f9`, react-redux `ad5d1e08`, zustand `beca84e6`, jotai `5c4ca26b`, query `46d7f02f`, db `7f0fa36f`, tldraw `5590d14d`, primitives `58164e06`, react `3a717e42`, router `3dee5b2e`, redux-toolkit `b1c51301`, redux-devtools `f4b4668c`).

The contract: **the recipient list must be fixed before delivery begins** — a subscriber that unsubscribes while a notification is in flight must neither be invoked afterwards nor change who else is invoked. Redux (`currentListeners`/`nextListeners` + `ensureCanMutateNextListeners`) and jotai (`flushCallbacks` collecting a `callbacks` Set before running any) already do this; the rest iterate a live `Set`/array/linked list.
